copy.select-project-create: In Dimo, create or choose a **project** to continue. A **project** is a folder that isolates Agent sessions and work state.
copy.select-project-global: **Global** is your user folder — click **Global** to continue.
copy.select-project-list: Click a project to open it
copy.toolbar-host-selector: This is the **Host selector**, for switching between Local Host and remote hosts.
copy.project-switcher: This is the **Project selector**, for switching projects, opening folders, or creating a new one.
copy.rail-session-list: This is the **Session list**, for viewing and switching workspace sessions.
copy.rail-bots: This is the **Bots** panel, for managing automated bots and sessions.
copy.rail-file-tree: This is the **File tree**, for browsing and opening project files.
copy.rail-git: This is the **Git panel**, for reviewing changes, commits, and branches.
